programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Sharyn Alfonsi, Anderson Cooper, Steve Kroft, Lara Logan, Norah O'Donnell, Scott Pelley, Charlie Rose, Lesley Stahl, Jon Wertheim, Oprah Winfrey and Bill Whitaker.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

Despite a relationship with Stevie (Jennifer Jason Leigh), a pretty prostitute, Trevor descends further into paranoia, blaming his problems on an enigmatic figure named Ivan (John Sharian).

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

programme.title: ACC Huddle
programme.desc: Boston College head coach Bill O'Brien, SMU head coach Rhett Lashlee and Virginia head coach Tony Elliott sit down with Wes Durham for an extended and in-depth conversation on play-calling. The coaches discuss whether play-calling is more of an art or science, who shaped and impacted how they call plays today, as well as how they have adapted as the game has changed over the years. The coaches also recall and give detailed breakdowns of the best and worst plays they have ever called.

programme.title: 1st Look
programme.desc: Each episode of this travel series sees the host becoming immersed with locals to experience unique culture, authentic cuisine and amazing conversations that turn every city into an unforgettable memory, and brings the world to the viewer through the exploration of inspiring and exciting destinations across the globe. Whether it's rediscovering a familiar road or taking the path less traveled, there is magic to be found around every corner. Every adventure starts with a "1st Look.".

programme.title: Open House
programme.desc: Buying a house can be a stressful, time-consuming process, which is why people turn to shows such as "Open House" to get help in the real estate market. Hosts Sara Gore and George Oliphant (who also rescues homeowners' renovation projects on sister show "George to the Rescue," which began as a segment of "Open House" before becoming a stand-alone show) showcase some of the hottest homes on the market in major cities, get interior design tips from experts and provide information on what people need to know about stylish living.

programme.desc: On January 18, 1958, Willie O'Ree made history with the Boston Bruins as the first black player to skate in a National Hockey League game. O'Ree went on to play professional hockey for 21 years, shattering a barrier that had stood for over 40 years and inspiring generations of young athletes to pursue their dreams. Willie didn't just play the game, he changed it forever.

programme.desc: El caso de Mauricio Leal conmocionó a Colombia en noviembre de 2021, cuando el reconocido estilista fue hallado muerto junto a su madre en su casa de La Calera. En un principio, la escena simulaba un homicidio-suicidio, pero la investigación reveló inconsistencias que llevaron a señalar a su hermano, Jhonier Leal, como el responsable. La fiscalía determinó que asesinó a ambos para quedarse con su patrimonio y luego intentó encubrir el crimen. En 2022, Jhonier Leal confesó y fue condenado.
